The '''Hylaia system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] known as the [[Hylaian marsh bamboo]].<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hylaia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
